title: How I Beat Imaru in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: GamerCory
description:
How I beat Imaru in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.

If you're struggling with the Imaru boss fight, this video shows the full fight and the strategy I used to take her down. Imaru is one of the major Fellhollow bosses, and the fight includes multiple phases, summoned enemies, dangerous ground attacks, and the Wither mechanic.

In this guide, I'll show you the gear and setup I used, how I handled the different phases, what to watch out for, and the strategy that worked for me.
